sections.overview: Page intro. Two-column layout: on the left a large heading, a subheading paragraph, and two CTA buttons; on the right a stacked group of three images.

sequences.description: Large heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', subheading paragraph, and two call-to-action buttons ('See case', 'All stories') in the left column.
Three images stacked/grouped in the right column (hip-hop dance, family vacation, music concert).

sections.overview: Article/case-study header. Two-column layout: large feature image on the left; breadcrumb, heading, and author/date byline on the right.

sequences.description: Large feature image (adventure spots, 3x2 aspect) in the left column.
Right column: breadcrumb (Home > Case studies), heading 'Fresh looks, bold moves, real stories', author byline 'By Taylor Brooks', and 'June 12, 2024 • 4 min read' meta.

sections.overview: Image gallery section. Centered heading and subheading, followed by a 4-column grid of eight square images.

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Style in every snapshot' and paragraph 'Peek the latest looks in action'.
Grid of eight uniform square images (4-column desktop, 2-column tablet, 1-column mobile). Images only, no text.

sections.overview: Interactive testimonial tabs. Active tab shows a person's image alongside their name, role, and quote. A 4-item tab menu of avatar cards (name + role) sits below to switch panels.

sequences.description: Tabbed interface with four switchable panels (Alex Rivera, Taylor Kim, Jordan Ellis, Morgan Blake). Each panel: person image + name + role + testimonial quote. Tab menu of four avatar cards (avatar image, name, role) toggles the active panel.

sections.overview: Latest articles section. Centered heading and subheading, followed by a 4-column grid of article cards.

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Latest articles' and paragraph 'Fresh looks, bold moves'.
Grid of four linked article cards, each with an image, a category tag (e.g. 'Casual Cool'), a date (e.g. 'May 12'), and a heading (e.g. 'Tennis style, redefined'). Whole card is a link.

sections.overview: FAQ section. Heading and subheading, followed by a list of four expandable question/answer items.

sequences.description: Heading 'Got questions? We've got answers.' and subheading 'Fashion FAQs, answered fast'.
Four expandable FAQ items (question summary + collapsible answer), rendered as HTML <details> elements.

sections.visualStyle: dark (inverse-section), full-width background image with dark overlay
sections.overview: Full-width closing hero. Background photo with a dark overlay; overlaid heading, subheading paragraph, and a single CTA button.

sequences.description: Full-width banner with background image and dark overlay. Overlaid content: heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', subheading paragraph, and 'See more' CTA button.
